cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (4096 MB = 4 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate. 512 MB is enough for a few players, give more for many guilds

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port Lavalink listens on (TCP, HTTP and WebSocket). Your bot connects here

password.desc: Password your bot uses to connect (the Authorization header). Applied on every start

javaversion.desc: Version of Java to run Lavalink with (17 or newer)

install.text:
# Written by Aether Panel on install, only when this file does not exist.
# The port and the password always come from the panel (SERVER_PORT and
# LAVALINK_SERVER_PASSWORD environment variables), the values below are a copy.
server:
  port: ${port}
  address: 0.0.0.0
  http2:
    enabled: false
lavalink:
  # YouTube needs the youtube-source plugin (https://github.com/lavalink-devs/youtube-source).
  # Uncomment and put its latest version, then restart:
  # plugins:
  #   - dependency: "dev.lavalink.youtube:youtube-plugin:VERSION"
  #     snapshot: false
  server:
    password: "${password}"
    sources:
      youtube: false
      bandcamp: true
      soundcloud: true
      twitch: true
      vimeo: true
      nico: true
      http: true
      local: false
    filters:
      volume: true
      equalizer: true
      karaoke: true
      timescale: true
      tremolo: true
      vibrato: true
      distortion: true
      rotation: true
      channelMix: true
      lowPass: true
    bufferDurationMs: 400
    frameBufferDurationMs: 5000
    opusEncodingQuality: 10
    resamplingQuality: LOW
    trackStuckThresholdMs: 10000
    useSeekGhosting: true
    youtubePlaylistLoadLimit: 6
    playerUpdateInterval: 5
    youtubeSearchEnabled: true
    soundcloudSearchEnabled: true
    gc-warnings: true
metrics:
  prometheus:
    enabled: false
    endpoint: /metrics
logging:
  file:
    path: ./logs/
  level:
    root: INFO
    lavalink: INFO
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: 100MB
      max-history: 7
